name: Whimsical
description: Whimsical is a visual workspace for product builders that combines flowcharts, mind maps, wireframes, and an infinite-canvas board with AI generation from text prompts.
best_for: Product builders, designers, and teams documenting processes and product ideas who want lightweight diagramming alongside wireframing in one tool.
features: Flowcharts and diagrams for mapping processes and shared understanding
Wireframes for exploring product UI/UX before high-fidelity design
Infinite-canvas boards for freeform visual work
Whimsical AI generates diagrams, mind maps, and wireframes from text prompts

alternatives.name: Miro
alternatives.description: An online collaborative whiteboard for brainstorming, diagramming, and workshops.
alternatives.best_for: Cross-functional teams running remote workshops and visual collaboration.

alternatives.name: Lucidchart
alternatives.description: A web-based diagramming tool for flowcharts, org charts, and technical diagrams.
alternatives.best_for: Teams needing structured diagramming and process documentation.

alternatives.name: Balsamiq
alternatives.description: A low-fidelity wireframing tool focused on structure over visual polish.
alternatives.best_for: Teams wanting to rapidly sketch and align on interface structure.

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: 50 board objects/month, 50 doc blocks/month, watermark on exports, 7-day version history.

cons: The Free plan caps creation at 50 board objects and 50 doc blocks per month and adds a watermark to exports.
Paid workspace billing is per editor; viewers and guests are free, so editor count drives recurring cost.
